countries.name: South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands

method: FRE from VIIRS (2012+) or harmonized MODIS/Aqua FRP at ~13:30 × diurnal integral (Gaussian + baseline fitted to Terra/Aqua day/night FRP per calendar month, actual overpass times per year); dry matter = 0.368 kg/MJ (Wooster et al. 2005); biome-generic emission factors with cross-biome range after Andreae (2019). No cloud correction: conservative.
